note: Both sets capture the section designations (C3X6, W8X10, W10X12, W10X15, L3x3x1/4, L4X4X5/16, PL5X3/8, PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2) and the 1/4" TYP dimensions with supporting quotes. Set A additionally extracts the HSS 4X4X1/4 member size, which is clearly present in the text and reference keynotes. Set B adds a plausible 1'-4" length for C3X6 but misbinds the TYP condition to W10X12 (the TYP in the text applies to the 1/4" weld/plate dimensions, not the beam section) and includes a vague duplicate 'section profile' claim. Set A's only notable weakness is the 'C3X6 quantity 1' claim, where the '1' is likely a detail callout rather than a quantity (a claim also present in B).
